## Checklist

- [ ] `task lint` and `task test` pass
- [ ] Commits follow [Conventional Commits](https://www.conventionalcommits.org/) (`type(scope): msg`)
- [ ] Regenerated code is committed if inputs changed (`task generate` after touching `api/openapi.yaml`, `ent/schema/`, or a mocked interface)
- [ ] New config keys are in `config.defaults()` and `api/config.schema.json`
- [ ] `docs/wiki/Roadmap.md` updated if this ships or starts a roadmap feature
- [ ] UI/UX change: screenshots or a video are attached below (required for anything that changes what a page looks like or how it behaves)
- [ ] I've read the diff and can explain every line — noted below if AI-assisted
      ([why](https://github.com/datahearth/streamline/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md#ai-assisted-contributions))

## Screenshots / video

<!--
REQUIRED for any UI/UX change: a new page or component, a layout, style or
copy change, or a change to how something behaves on screen. A UI PR without
them is sent back before review. Delete this section only if nothing visible
changes.

- Before and after, side by side, for a change to something that exists.
- Desktop (around 1440 px wide) AND phone width (around 390 px): below `md`
  the app swaps to bottom navigation, sheets and a search page, so a change
  that looks right on one can be broken on the other.
- A short video or GIF for anything that moves: a flow, an animation, a
  sheet, a swipe, a drag, a loading or error state.
- Drag the files into this box: GitHub uploads them and inserts the links.
- Use a library you can show publicly: no personal data, and nothing you
  wouldn't want in a public issue tracker.
